concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-015 (CPU‑tractable definition: max memory ≤ 7 GB, max latency ≤ 5 min per PR) has no dedicated task enforcing or measuring these constraints. No task mentions monitoring memory usage limits or latency budgets, so the requirement cannot be verified.

Success Criterion SC-004 (computational feasibility: record total runtime for 500 PRs and compare to a target threshold) is not linked to any task. The pipeline lacks a task that measures overall execution time or reports it against a benchmark, making this criterion untestable.
